avis.titre: Great cleanser to start your day!
avis.texte: I've been using Estée Lauder DayWear Glow Boost Jelly Cleanser as my morning cleanse, and it's a really pleasant start to the day. It's a solid everyday cleanser, especially if you want something gentle but still effective.

avis.titre: My skin feels fresh,soft and clean
avis.texte: As a tired mom who sometimes washes her face at 11:47 PM while questioning every life decision, I need a cleanser that works without drama. The Estée Lauder DayWear Cleanser? She understood the assignment. It has this creamy texture that foams just enough to feel satisfying, like you are actually removing the day off your face. Makeup, sunscreen, toddler fingerprints, stress. Gone. But somehow my skin does not feel tight or squeaky stripped after. It feels clean in a rich girl at the spa kind of way, not gas station bathroom soap kind of way. I have combination skin, and this did not freak it out. My T zone felt fresh, my cheeks stayed comfortable, and my skin felt soft and balanced after rinsing. No dryness. No irritation. Just calm, clean, expensive energy. The scent is light and fresh. Not aggressive. Not headache inducing. Just subtle and elevated, like you have your life together even if you absolutely do not. Overall, this feels like a dependable everyday cleanser that makes washing your face feel a little luxurious. And honestly, as a mom, I will take any small moment of luxury I can get.

This worked better than I thought it would to be honest! A lot of cleansers I have tried with this gel like formula aren't great at removing makeup. I received this product for free from Estee Lauder for testing and review purposes.
